status: pre-registered before execution and before any 32-seed outcome was inspected
authorization: user-authorized 128-seed extension of the 32-seed screen, requested while the 32-seed cohort was running

cohort.seeds: 0..127 (128 paired seeds): 0..31 from the 32-seed screen plus new 32..127
cohort.execution: 48 new jobs (2 arms x 24 shards of 4 seeds, offsets 32..124), interleaved, xargs -P4 on 4 cores, started automatically after the 32-seed jobs; no profile or scan

analysis: merge all 32 shards per arm; python3 paired_analysis.py control.csv shared.csv

decision_rule.primary: paired win-rate difference shared - control, analyzer 95% bootstrap interval, on seeds 0..127
decision_rule.reject: interval upper bound below 0, or paired mean floor difference interval entirely below 0
decision_rule.support: interval lower bound above 0 -> candidate for a default change via ADR and a fresh confirmation cohort
decision_rule.neutral: interval spans 0 -> no default change; option stays research-only
decision_rule.note: the 32-seed screen result is reported separately but does not gate this extension
